Name: Amariah, Son of Hezekiah
Summary: Amariah, son of Hezekiah, is named only in Zephaniah's genealogy (Zephaniah 1:1), as the prophet's great-grandfather. He is one of several Amariahs in Scripture; this one is identified by his place in Zephaniah's line.
KeyStory: Amariah appears only in Zephaniah's genealogy, as the prophet's great-grandfather between Gedaliah and Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: Zephaniah; Gedaliah, Son of Amariah; Hezekiah, Son of Amariah
LifeLesson: Amariah's one verse holds a whole generation together. Most of God's people live their lives in a single line of a genealogy — and that is enough.
